title: Caren M NDE 6677
content: The night of the event I went with a friend of mine to her relative’s house. I had never met them before. We sat down and they offered me a drink, which I accepted. After a few minutes I felt extremely dizzy and felt like I was going to black out. I excused myself and went outside. The last thing I remember was closing the front door before I was in this dark place. It was as if I was in the sky at night with no stars or clouds, but I could see fine. I could not move or say anything, but I'm not sure if that was because I was so scared or some other reason. I was standing between two hooded robed figures like monks wear. I knew that they were trying to decide (fight over) what my fate was going to be. I felt at the time that it was Jesus and Satan. They did not speak in words; I just knew this to be. It was like telepathy, but more direct. I also remember a large circle, but I do not remember what its purpose was. The next thing I knew my friend was shaking me and slapping my face. I remember that I could hardly breathe or catch my breath, and I was afraid I was going to die again. I felt sheer terror like I have never known, and never want to feel again, but I do not remember why. It feels like either I was not allowed to remember or I can't because I won't let myself. At that point, I was at the end of her relative’s driveway lying by the road. She said to me, ‘I thought you were gone.’ She said she found me lying on her uncle's cactus (by the front door). I do not know how I got to the end of the driveway. I doubt that she could have carried me herself, and I never asked.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Dark place described as being in the sky at night with no stars or clouds, but could still see fine.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Experiencer felt the two hooded robed figures were "Jesus and Satan."
arrival.other_being_detail: Two hooded robed figures like monks; experiencer perceived them as deciding/fighting over her fate.

environment.environment_other_detail: Night-sky-like darkness with no stars or clouds; visibility still possible.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Abruptly back to being physically shaken/slapped by friend; no described transitional process.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: After accepting a drink at a relative’s house, felt extremely dizzy and blacked out; later found lying outside and had trouble breathing (possible drugging/poisoning or medical collapse not specified).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Two hooded robed figures perceived as Jesus and Satan deciding/fighting over her fate; remembered a large circle of unknown purpose; inability to move or speak; intense terror; abrupt return when friend shook/slapped her.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Blackout into a dark void-like setting with two beings and telepathic knowing; no OBE/tunnel/light/life review/boundary described; abrupt return to body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Standing between two hooded robed figures perceived as Jesus and Satan who were "trying to decide (fight over) what my fate was going to be"; recalled a "large circle" with unknown purpose; found later at end of driveway with unclear how she got there.
